description: This file defines a centralized mock function type for Vitest testing framework, intended to be used for mock functions in harness modules under 'src/'. It explicitly types mock functions to avoid exporting inferred `vi.fn()` types that could cause type errors.

ctags.name: MockFn
ctags.pattern: /^export type MockFn<T extends (...args: any[]) => any = (...args: any[]) => any> =$/
